topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture by outlining the learning objectives and establishing the hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Deregulation of growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how oncogenic mutations dysregulate cell-surface receptors and intracellular signaling cascades to drive continuous proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Blocks in terminal differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how differentiation blocks prevent cells from reaching functional terminal states in both hematological malignancies and solid carcinomas.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the mitochondrial apoptotic pathway and the mechanisms by which cancer cells disable p53 and alter the balance of death regulators to avoid apoptosis.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and growth-control summary
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how telomere shortening triggers senescence, how cancer cells overcome this barrier through TERT reactivation to achieve replicative immortality, and conclude the discussion of growth-control hallmarks.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how cancer cells rewire cellular metabolism toward aerobic glycolysis and how metabolic enzyme mutations produce epigenetic-modifying oncometabolites.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the angiogenic switch and regulatory balance required to establish a blood supply for expanding tumors.

topics.label: Tumor invasion, metastasis, and systemic dissemination
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the multi-step cascade of metastatic dissemination, the factors governing colonization efficiency at secondary sites, and the genomic features of metastatic clones.

topics.label: Lecture summary and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: It closes the lecture with a concluding summary of cancer hallmark interactions and suggested supplementary reading.
